title: •Trained In The Jedi Arts
caption: •Qui-Gon’s End (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your {lightsaber} and {maintenance} cards are lost. “Vader” on your Interrupts may be treated as “Maul or Mara Jade.” Wherever you have an Effect with “skill” in its game text, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. {alter}
lore: While Qui-Gon spent years maintaining peace, Maul was sharpening his combat skills. Those years of training came to fruition in one fateful moment.

heading: •Trained In The Jedi Arts (V)
notes: Group: Everything else. Unique. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1100) on the red Effect frame: Effect-type disc (green swirl, as printed), title '•Trained In The Jedi Arts', destiny 5; white window covers lore box + art (no lore on the slip → printed lore stays, as on the VB5 reissue). Banner EFFECT (printed: IMMEDIATE EFFECT; no grabber box). Inline icons: black square with green blade → {lightsaber} (brief); gold spoked wheel on brown in a square → {maintenance} (brief; same pair as vs12/13); trailing red circle-slash A → {alter}. The stub reads the two icons as 'Reflections III and Coruscant cards' — the slip does not show set spheres there. Curly quotes as printed. Caption '•Qui-Gon’s End (V)'. CHANGES vs Decipher Qui-Gon's End (Reflections III): title; destiny 5, lore, disc unchanged; banner IMMEDIATE EFFECT → EFFECT; game text replaced (printed: 'Deploy on a site where Maul just defeated Qui-Gon in lightsaber combat. Place Qui-Gon out of play. While Obi-Wan at this site, his lightsaber combat total is +2 and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each of your turns. (Immune to Control.)'). Ring icons on the printed card: Reflections III + Episode I. Lore matches the scan; copyright 2001 line read on the scan. 350 px scan only. Modern: VB5-D-trainedinthejediarts-pre.gif (same text and icons). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
